response.justification: The candidate is a highly skilled senior software engineer with 20 years of experience, but is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. Most critically, they lack native-level Japanese language proficiency (a required qualification), have no experience with embedded systems or security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption), minimal recent C programming (only 6 months in 2014-2015), and no Linux kernel investigation experience. Their expertise is in web, cloud, and general software development, not embedded networking firmware.
strengths: 20+ years of software development experience demonstrating consistent ability to learn new technologies and paradigms across multiple domains
Strong software engineering fundamentals with proven expertise in TDD, clean architecture, and DevOps infrastructure (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes)
Fluent English proficiency and demonstrated experience collaborating across teams on technically complex projects
concerns: Completely lacks native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is a required qualification for this position
No experience with embedded systems, firmware development, or network security technologies (cryptography, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
Minimal C programming in last 12 years (only 6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015) and no demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or modification capability

key_factors.factor: No Embedded Systems or Networking Security Domain Expertise
Limited Recent C Programming and Kernel Experience
